cmds.say: Dawn on the Tamasa river. Mist lies on the water, and birds stir in the ashoka trees of the hermitage.
You are {player}, a young student in the hermitage of the sage Valmiki.
{player}, come and sit with us. The sage Narada has been speaking with me all through the night.
Every story worth telling begins with a question, child. Listen to how this one begins.
These are the very first words of the poem: Valmiki, the {w:tapasvin} (ascetic), questions Narada, the best of speakers.
And this is the question I asked him. It has filled my heart ever since.
Such a man lives, Valmiki. He is Rama, born in the line of Ikshvaku.
I must go on my way. Tell his story well, and let this child help you.
Narada lifts his vina and walks away into the morning light.
Now let us go down to the Tamasa to bathe. Bharadvaja has gone ahead to the ford with my bark cloth.
To walk, use the arrow keys, WASD or the D-pad. To talk to someone or read a sign, face it and press A (Z, Enter or Space).
Press Menu (M) to see your party, your items, your word book {n:ui.words}, your verse book {n:ui.verses}, and the settings.

cmds.objective: Go south to the bank of the Tamasa.

cmds.say: Fruit and forest honey, fresh today. Take what you need for the road.
Fruit, roots, honey and healing herbs. Everything a traveller needs.
The shrine beside me is a place of peace. Face it and press A.
Rest there to heal your party, save your journey, or recite a verse you have heard. A recited verse is restored and gives your heroes new strength.
